Handwritten Arabic · line-level recognition

Arabic Handwriting OCR Leaderboard

Character- and word-error rates for OCR / vision-language models transcribing cursive handwritten Arabic, scored on the same held-out lines with the same metrics.

32 model(s) · 38 run(s) · 7 dataset(s) — Muharaf handwriting + KITAB-Bench subsets

CER / WER
edit distance to the reference, over characters / words. 0 = perfect.
raw
exact strings — every orthographic and diacritic difference counts.
light
alef forms, digits, tatweel and spacing normalized first.
no-diac
light, and harakat stripped from both sides.
micro / macro
corpus-weighted total vs. mean of per-line rates.
diac F1
precision/recall of harakat marks, measured on raw text.

All results — CER-light / WER-light

Every model × dataset in one grid. Top number is CER·light %, smaller number below is WER·light % (both lower = better). The best model on each dataset is bold; cells carry a faint green→red wash by CER. Click a dataset name to sort the model columns best→worst on it. · = not run on that dataset.
